company.name: StoryWorth
company.shortDescription: StoryWorth makes it easy for people to privately record their family stories.
company.description: StoryWorth is a service that makes it easy for families to record their stories. Each week they email their customers a question about their life, for example "What do you remember of your grandmother?". Their customers reply by email or by phone, and the stories are saved and shared privately with their family.

productsAndServices.description: A guided storytelling service that helps individuals record life stories and photos through weekly prompts, then compile them into a printed hardcover memoir.

productsAndServices.description: A collaborative book service for collecting stories, memories, advice, photos, and well wishes from multiple contributors and publishing them as a customized hardcover keepsake.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,163,319 to $3,825,697, a 1.77x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 72 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 48 (-21).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Remento, StoryCorps, Legacybox.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
